name: show_checks
description: Show checks as they run: each its label, its status (pending, running, passed, failed) and what it found; a failed one how to fix it and a link to act on it. Call it again as the checks move on; it updates in place. Only shows it; there is no reply.

actionLabel.description: For a failed check: what its link says, e.g. Open Docker settings

actionUrl.description: For a failed check: where its link goes, https

fix.description: For a failed check: how to put it right, markdown

label.description: What is checked, e.g. Docker answers
